facts.claim: 叙述者在门口把护照交给 Abi，Abi 转交给守卫 Ernesto 查验
facts.quote: Abi handed him my passport while exchanging a few sentences in Spanish

facts.claim: Ernesto 打开后备箱，并蹲下检查车底
facts.quote: He even crouched down to inspect the underside of the vehicle

facts.claim: Ernesto 解开铁丝网门的挂锁、开门放行
facts.quote: undid a padlock in the chain-link fence, opened the gate

facts.claim: Abi 说 Ernesto 是白班守卫，下午两点上到夜里十点
facts.quote: He works from two in the afternoon till ten at night

facts.claim: 叙述者猜出夜班守卫（Ernesto 的孪生兄弟）叫 Alberto，Abi 伸手与他击掌
facts.quote: She put her hand out for a high five that I felt obliged to return

facts.claim: 叙述者自己下车取行李，不让司机动手
facts.quote: I scrambled out of the car to make it clear to the driver

facts.claim: Abi 告诉叙述者这宅子里外都没有摄像头
facts.quote: You know there are no cameras? Inside or out.

facts.claim: Abi 用肩膀轻撞叙述者，说重要的是里面
facts.quote: She leaned in my direction, nudging me playfully with her shoulder

relations.rel: 熟人：她用西语打招呼，他是宅子的白班守卫
relations.quote: Abi waved at the guard, who took his time looking up from his screen

relations.rel: 孪生兄弟：一个上白班、一个上夜班
relations.quote: happens to be Ernesto’s twin brother

relations.rel: 同车抵达 Sweet Spot，叙述者承认两人已经交好
relations.quote: I suppose Abi Brooke and I really had bonded.

relations.rel: Abi 替 Genevieve 的宅子做车辆查验与访客引路
relations.quote: Genevieve is super thorough with any vehicle that enters the property

relations.rel: 叙述者推断她痛恨被拍摄记录
relations.quote: Genevieve Caraway hated the idea of people watching and recording her movements

numbers.claim: 夜里全黑后气温又降了十度
numbers.quote: the temperature had dropped another ten degrees

numbers.claim: 白班守卫 Ernesto 的上班时间
numbers.quote: two in the afternoon till ten at night

numbers.claim: 白班守卫 Ernesto 的下班时间
numbers.quote: two in the afternoon till ten at night

numbers.claim: 作者故意把时间倒回假想的午后一点来看房子
numbers.quote: So let’s pretend it was one in the afternoon

numbers.claim: Ernesto 去还护照、开门的时耗
numbers.quote: Ernesto returned a minute or two later with my passport

numbers.claim: 过门后两人无言开车的时长
numbers.quote: We rode in silence for a few minutes

numbers.claim: 宅子正面两侧的塔楼数量
numbers.quote: flanked by what looked to be two towers

turning_point: 叙述者随 Abi 穿过全宅唯一的门、抵达沙漠中的 Sweet Spot：宅子正面像无窗的砂岩城堡、寸草不生，Abi 说这一切只为让人看不进来。
notes: （1）叙述者全章未出现姓名，relations 中以「我」代称。（2）本章中段作者明说用 authorial discretion 把时间从夜里扳回午后，故「one in the afternoon」是假想钟点，不是实际抵达时间。（3）「ten degrees」未给单位（华氏/摄氏不明）。（4）Ernesto 全名、Alberto 是否真名章内未再确认。
